pitch:
FLUGIA gives your business AI co-workers: an AI Marketing Manager, an AI Sales Manager and an AI Customer Support Manager (HR, finance and assistant co-workers coming soon).
They connect to the tools you already use (CRM, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365...), learn your business through a shared knowledge base, and run the automations you choose, 24/7. No technical skills needed; a human Customer Success team does your onboarding.
Standard plan: all AI co-workers, 3 users, 100 FLUGIA credits a month, for 99 € a month, or 59 € a month if you pay yearly (-40%). Extra users 9,99 € a month.
Free plan: one AI co-worker, 1 user, 50 credits in total. Enterprise: 199 € a month (99 € a month yearly), 5 users, 300 credits a month, custom modules.
GDPR-compliant, with data access controlled by you. Create an account or book a free demo at flugia.com.
